svg.title: Intervexa — AI interview simulator
svg.desc: Mock interviews that adapt to every answer: technical, coding, system design and behavioral rounds, voice in 8 languages, and a memory of your weak spots for the next session. Built with Next.js 15, MongoDB, Gemini · Claude, Auth.js.
